title: Refresh operating layer
summary: When the active connection's relay follows a release, it refreshes and publishes each mapped installed checkout with the installed CLI. Source-linked and missing checkouts are skipped. Failed refreshes remain in the machine-local operator-cli-follow.json record; every project or global session startup and the steering report name still-stale failed checkouts with their reason and yoke project install recovery. The advisory shows at most five checkouts and names the record for the remainder.
